استشيرا (form X)
# اُسْتُشِيرَا (ustušīrā) /us.tu.ʃiː.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَشَارَ (istašāra)
# اِسْتَشِيرَا (istašīrā) /is.ta.ʃiː.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَشَارَ (istašāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
